positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Bible Journal— Swift, SwiftUI, SwiftData, CloudKit
Apple AppStore - A rich Bible focused application that allows users to read, write, and reflect. Built on SwiftUI it has 5
stars and an active userbase and *250 MAU.
• Built the UI to be modern and follow Apple Human Interface guidelines. Responsive and reactive to user interaction
utilizing efficient State management and modern architecture - Observable Macro and MVVM.
• Utilized Apples own SwiftData and CoreData frameworks due to data protection and security focuses. Due to the
nature of the journal/notes functionality, data protection was the most important thing. Swiftdata allows on device
and iCloud sync without the need for external off accont data transfer.
• Built out backend in Express that serves as a proxy API to deliver rich Bible text JSON and audio streaming.
Delivered via serverless functions for speed and overhead mindfulness. This API is constantly expanded to add more
content and routing for efficiency and customization to the apps needs.
Bible-Journal.com— Next.js, TypeScript, CloudKit
A web Front-End for Bible Journal app. Built around the same design principles utilizaing ShadCN UI for functional,
reusable components.
• Designed around responsive mobile first functionality this app utlizized ShadCN’s component library to provide reusable, highly customizable UI components.
• In ode to Swift, utilized Typescripts strong type safety to leverage security and maintainability between application
stages and state changes. UI should remain and free from load shifting while the functionality is performant and
gives users ques from loading state to fully rendered. Maintains same core functionality as it’s iOS counterpart in a
reading first, journal second methodology.

positions.title: Account Manager
positions.description:
Collaborate with clients to launch and maintain website services, ranging from multi-location websites with complex structures to simple, basic page websites, tailored to meet individual client needs.
Provide comprehensive digital marketing services, including SEO and SEM, by building campaign plans, targeting specific locations and keywords, covering metric reports monthly, and setting monthly and year-over-year goals.
Maintain existing client sites with optimizations and adjustments depending on seasonality and client needs, including tasks such as homepage overhauls and complete redesigns.
Prioritize client care through consistent communication channels, promptly addressing concerns, and proactively implementing solutions to meet client objectives.
Implement client retention strategies focused on building long-term relationships and fostering trust..
Apply attentive client management techniques, including personalized support and tailored solutions to individual client needs.  Emphasizing exceptional customer service and support to maximize client success and engagement.
positions.insights: Digital Marketing, Project Management and +3 skills

positions.title: Account Manager
positions.description:
Client Care:
 
• Receive incoming calls from clients, addressing their inquiries, concerns, and requests in a professional and courteous manner.
• Provide accurate and up-to-date information about T-Mobile products, services, promotions, and account-related details.
• Offer personalized solutions and recommendations to meet clients' specific needs, demonstrating a deep understanding of their accounts.
Account Management:
• Handle and process clients' account payable needs, including bill payments, refunds, and adjustments, ensuring accuracy and timeliness.
• Conduct regular account reviews to identify opportunities for upselling or cross-selling relevant T- Mobile products and services.
• Collaborate with other departments, such as billing, technical support, and sales, to resolve complex account-related issues and provide comprehensive solutions.
Documentation and Reporting:
• Maintain accurate and detailed records of client interactions, inquiries, and resolutions using CRM tools or other designated systems.
• Generate reports and analyze data related to client accounts, service levels, and customer satisfaction, providing insights to improve processes and enhance client care.
positions.insights: Sales, Customer Relationship Management (CRM) and +1 skill
